_comment: GOLDEN-63, 30 epoch, SLANT-IONO / BIAS-ABSORPTION arm — drops BOTH the co-estimated
SH-VTEC field and the W6 satellite code-bias slice, leaving the free per-(rx,sat) slant
ionosphere to absorb the code-bias lumps.  Matched control is
_golden63_gps_30ep_shon.json; the two differ in exactly these two knobs plus lineage.
THIS IS THE ODIJK IONO-FLOAT MODEL, not a degraded posture.  Odijk et al. 2016 Table 8:
the estimable slant iono is  i~^r_s = i^r_s + d_{r,GF}(1) - d^s_{GF}(1)  — the receiver
and satellite GF code-bias lumps ride INSIDE the slant iono parameter.  The loader states
the same thing operationally (GnssConfigLoadNetwork.cpp:2060-2064): 'the satellite DCB is
co-linear with the free per-(rx,sat) slant iono until the GIM imposes between-satellite
structure'.  So with no iono constraint there is nothing to separate, and deferring the
satellite code bias is the CONFORMANT choice, not a loss of information.  The supported
path is explicit: GnssConfigLoadNetwork.cpp:2079 logs 'Network producer (V1): satellite
code bias deferred'.  The only ILLEGAL combination is estimate_sat_code_bias ON with
estimate_iono_sh OFF (:2208) — that one is a hard error.  Both OFF is legal.
WHY IT SHOULD BE FAST: it removes TWO blocks from the SHARED dimension at once — the
SH-VTEC coefficients (deg-8 = 81 coeffs on this 63-sta lineage; deg-15 = 256 at 305) and
the satellite code-bias columns (n_cb measured 130 on the 63-sta triple arm).  Measured
shared dimension with both ON: nshared = 405 at 63 sta.  cov-consumers scales ~O(n_s^2)
in that dimension and is the single largest epoch term at 305, so the expected win is
large and superlinear.  READ nshared IN THE LOG to confirm the drop actually happened —
if nshared is unchanged, a knob did not take effect (that failure mode already bit the
estimate_sat_code_bias:false arm, which estimate_iono_sh silently forced back on).
⚠️ WHAT IT COSTS — name these before quoting any speed number as a win:
1. NO self-contained satellite OSB.  enable_code_phase_bias (.BIA) is no longer forced
off, so external IGS bias products become the code-bias source.  The W6 'network is
the single code-bias source' property of this lineage is gone.
2. NO network iono field to emit.  network_vtec_sh.csv and the SH traces go empty, and
the closed-loop consumer's consume_network_iono has nothing to consume.  That matters:
the recorded ROOT CAUSE of the producer's 0% AR fix rate was the consumer never being
fed the ionosphere (weak iono-float user model = the fast-AR bottleneck, Odijk-2012 /
TK-2015 BLUP Eq 73).  Dropping SH regresses exactly that, UNLESS the per-LOS slant
iono is emitted instead — which is not wired today.
3. It contradicts a STANDING DIRECTIVE ('SH-VTEC-always-on is a datum, not a nicety').
This arm exists because the directive was explicitly reopened for a cost measurement;
it is NOT a promotion of the posture.  Do not inherit this config into a science
lineage without revisiting that decision.
SCOPE: 30 epochs measures COST ONLY.  It is inside ignition — no total_IF, no carry
retention, no AR claim.  Grade on D0/D0b section medians over settled epochs.
FRESH LINEAGE ONLY.  Own paths; never resume onto another arm's snapshot.
